title.en: We’ve Received Your Feedback. Now What? · Eight Languages

summary.en: The later introduction adds complete German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Korean rewrites, including all seven sections and the five-question checklist. The original twelve-paper route and existing Chinese and English prose remain intact.
